field.label: Title
field.hint: The name of the dataset, as others should cite it.

field.label: Abstract
field.hint: What the data contain, which place and period they describe, and what they are good for.

field.label: Creators
field.hint: People or organisations who made the data, in citation order. For a person, fill in surname and given name. For an organisation, put its full name in the surname box and use no comma.

field.label: Creator identifiers
field.hint: Optional. One row for each creator with an ORCID, a ROR or an affiliation. Copy the name exactly as it appears in Creators. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Data language
field.hint: Language of the data content: labels, attribute values, documents. Start typing the language name. For purely numeric data, type "linguistic" and choose the no-linguistic-content entry (code zxx).

field.label: Metadata language
field.hint: Language of the title, abstract and other text in this record.

field.label: Resource type
field.hint: One dataset, or a series of datasets made to the same specification.

field.label: Creation date
field.hint: When the data were made, as YYYY-MM-DD.

field.label: Publication date
field.hint: Keep "today" to publish with the date the item is approved, or enter YYYY-MM-DD.

field.label: Version
field.hint: The data's own version or edition, e.g. 2.1 or 2024.

field.label: Last revision
field.hint: When the data were last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD. Not the date of this record.

field.label: Lineage
field.hint: How the data were made: sources, processing steps and known limits of quality.

field.label: INSPIRE theme
field.hint: The INSPIRE data theme the data belong to.

field.label: ISO topic category
field.hint: The broad ISO 19115 topic that catalogues use for searching.

field.label: Research field (FORD)
field.hint: The OECD research field that CCMM requires. Choose the most specific one that fits.

field.label: Keywords
field.hint: Free keywords in the metadata language. Press Enter after each one.

field.label: Keywords from a vocabulary
field.hint: A term from a published vocabulary such as GEMET or EuroVoc, with the vocabulary's title, web address and publication date. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Bounding box
field.hint: The area the data cover, in WGS 84 degrees with a decimal point. If the area crosses the 180° meridian, enter two boxes. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Place names
field.hint: Names of the places the data cover, e.g. Prague or Šumava National Park.

field.label: Place identifiers
field.hint: Web addresses of the same places in a gazetteer such as RÚIAN, NUTS, GeoNames or Wikidata.

field.label: Period covered
field.hint: The time the data describe, not when they were made. Both dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Spatial resolution
field.hint: Fill in one box per row: the ground distance in metres (10 for a 10 m grid) or the scale denominator (25000 for 1:25 000). Use the same kind in every row. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Coordinate reference system
field.hint: The coordinate system of the data files as an EPSG web address, e.g. http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/5514 for S-JTSK / Krovak East North.

field.label: Spatial representation
field.hint: How the data store geography: vector features, a grid, a table, or a triangulated network.

field.label: Access
field.hint: Who can get the data. It must agree with the licence and the file permissions.

field.label: Limitation on public access
field.hint: The INSPIRE ground for limiting public access, with a short explanation. Leave it empty for open data; it then means no limitations. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Use conditions and fees
field.hint: Conditions on top of the licence, such as fees or a requested citation. Leave empty if there are none.

field.label: Downloads
field.hint: One row for each download: a short name, its file format, format version if known, size in bytes, and its direct link if it has one. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Map or data services
field.hint: Web services that serve these data, e.g. a WMS. Give the service address, a name and the service type. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Related resources
field.hint: Links to publications, documentation, source data or other versions, each with how it relates to this dataset. A DOI already assigned elsewhere goes here as "Is identical to". Do not type semicolons.

field.label: Funding
field.hint: Who paid for the work: the funder, its ROR or Crossref Funder ID, and the grant number, title and web address if known. Do not type semicolons.

field.label: INSPIRE conformity
field.hint: Whether the data conform to Commission Regulation (EU) No 1089/2010, with a short explanation. Leave empty if this was not evaluated. Do not type semicolons.
